<DOCSTRING>
Manages a collection of users and processes each user.

This class is responsible for maintaining a list of users and processing each user to determine if they are an adult or a minor. It is used by the user management service to handle user data and enforce access control based on age.

@constructor
Initializes a new instance of the UserManager class.

@attribute {Array<Object>} users - The list of users managed by this class. This attribute is initialized as an empty array and is modified by the `addUser` method.

@method {void} addUser(user) - Adds a user to the system and processes it.
- @param {Object} user - The user object to add. This parameter is required and must be a valid user object.

@method {void} process(user) - Logs whether a user is an adult or a minor.
- @param {Object} user - The user object to check. This parameter is required and must be a valid user object.
- @returns {void} - This function does not return a value.
</DOCSTRING>
